item.title: Make a plan after a missed delivery
item.summary: A delivery worker and a resident work around a building access problem.
item.transcript_text:
Pavel: I couldn't deliver your chair this morning. The apartment number was right, but the outer door was locked.
Lina: The bell for flat nine is broken. Can you come tomorrow when the building office is open?
Pavel: I can bring it between ten and twelve. The driver needs a name at the office, though.
Lina: Ask for Kim. I'll tell her the chair is for me, not for the office. The driver does not need to carry it upstairs.

questions.prompt: What are they trying to solve?
options: How to complete a furniture delivery
questions.explanation: They agree on a new delivery time and access plan.
Pavel had the right number but could not get inside.
Lina relies on the office instead of the bell.

questions.prompt: Who should the driver ask for?
questions.explanation: Kim is the stated office contact.

questions.prompt: Where can the driver leave the chair?
questions.explanation: Lina makes arrangements with Kim and says the driver need not go upstairs.
